evidence:
Sources read: frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx via zipfile in memory (Quality Checks row 30 / #29: 'The gate dimensions (render/constraints) carry the real gate, and every scored prompt carries the in-dimension gate that hard-zeros blank/static-shell apps (plus auth/backing checks when the app has them). Network is public, so the gate must NOT require same-origin.'; Internal Quality Checks row 30 (older wording incl. 'cross-origin', superseded by the public-network Quality Checks wording; no column-E annotation on this row); Deterministic Checks check-rubric-prompt.py 'scored prompts must also restate the in-dimension browser gate'); rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md, references/quality-checks.md #29 (Defect: gate requiring same-origin, or scored prompt giving partial credit on gate failure), references/staged-task-contract.md 'prompt.md and app_context.md'; frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests (gate and scored prompts, test.sh, score.py); qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md ('Gates must exclude convincing dead apps ... actual successful operation and independent-context readback'); handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md (lessons 4, 9, 13, 16 checked for this row).

Real gates: tests/gates/render/judge.toml:19-26 hro_gate_render (binary, all_pass): an incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out, then Rafael's correct password signs in to a usable staff workspace; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' -> auth leg with positive control (render/prompt.md:9). tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:19-26 hro_gate_shared (binary, all_pass): UI add of a uniquely named candidate to the seeded Data Analyst job, reload still signed in with the card, a new independent empty browser context as Observer finds exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save does not satisfy the gate' -> backing leg with a real write plus independent-context readback, as REVIEW_POLICY requires. constraints/prompt.md:9 gives the newContext recipe and says a reload or second tab is not independent. scoring.toml render=0.0, constraints=0.0; test.sh:213-221 runs gates then score.py, exit 1 stops, anything else writes zero (test.sh and score.py identical to the frozen template). Seed has JOB-DATA 'Data Analyst', Rafael recruiter, Aud observer; instruction.md:19 lists these accounts; hireops_rules.md section 1 Observer 'reads the board', section 2 add candidate with name/email/source; only Interview has a capacity limit (section 3), so repeated gate cards cannot fill Applied.

In-dimension gate in every scored prompt: functional/prompt.md:13-17 (same add/reload/independent Observer readback; 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives this criterion 0'; functional is mode=individual, so each of the 15 sessions re-runs it and zeros its own criterion, i.e. the whole dimension). polish/prompt.md:9-12 ('gives binary0 throughout'; all 5 polish criteria are binary). visual/prompt.md:9-12 ('gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'; all 5 visual criteria are likert points=5). No partial credit on gate failure anywhere. The tool-failure clause in all five prompts returns binary0/Likert1 'NOT EXERCISED', never a pass.

Same-origin: grep -i 'origin' over task/tests, instruction.md and environment/instructions finds no same-origin requirement (only 'original'). Prompts use http://localhost:3000 only (lesson 13 satisfied). instruction.md:15 and integration.md allow CDN assets. The template functional prompt's 'Replays use an in-page call from the app's own origin' wording is absent from the task.

Weak-app probes: (a) client-only/localStorage app -> fails independent-context readback; (b) static shell or seed-only JSON -> fails UI add/readback; (c) server that answers success without saving -> 'no-op success' fails; (d) in-memory server store passes the gate but is caught by hro_intake_restart's restart leg - acceptable, durability is scored not gated (lesson 4: load, reload, server-backed). Conforming-alternative probes: different routes/labels (prompts say discover by intent); another working staff account accepted for the Observer leg; an app that loses its session on every reload is arguably nonconforming given instruction.md:7,13 ('reload, and make sure nothing breaks') and rules section 6 drafts/session-ends wording, so the stay-signed-in leg is not a hidden requirement. Lesson 16 double-grading not triggered (gate failure zeros everything, no partial double penalty). Lesson 9 step reporting is present in functional/polish/visual prompts.

Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json entries re-hashed: all 8 artifact sha256 values match and all matching_source_files match the frozen task bytes. qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/workspace.cjs:318-332 and results/workspace.json show the golden passing a scripted version of the gate ('gate: a candidate added to a seeded job survives a reload and is read back by the Observer in another context', passed true). That is a scripted Playwright run, not a configured judge run; no configured judge execution of the gate dimensions or the in-dimension gates against the golden or against a dead app exists, so gate behavior under the actual judge (false zero of the golden or false pass of a dead app) is unmeasured. Risk remains true for that missing evidence.

Minor note (not a defect for this row): about 17-18 gate cards accumulate in Data Analyst Applied across judge sessions; criteria use their own suffixed cards and the visual read-only review may use any seeded job.
